does_not_invalidate: The v1.0 raw-yaw failure and its report remain retained evidence.
amendment_reason: Yaw is an element of the circle S1. Values separated by exactly 2*pi encode the same orientation; raw scalar subtraction is not a physically valid orientation metric.
action_sequence: Unchanged from v1.0 deterministic bounded multi-sine sequence.

acceptance.rule: Every component at every step passes; yaw distance is abs(atan2(sin(a-b),cos(a-b))). Missing plant support is not a pass.

negative_control: Perturb thruster_tau_s from 0.25 to 0.251; comparison must fail.
